category: hosted customer identity and access management for B2B SaaS (hosted login, users, tenants, SSO, SCIM)

free_tier.stated: Pay as you go: $0 per month for up to 7,500 monthly active users, 5 enterprise connections (SSO/SCIM), unlimited organizations, fully customized hosted login and a custom domain; no credit card needed to start; unlimited team seats
free_tier.notes: A monthly active user is a user who logs in at least once in a calendar month. SSO and SCIM are counted separately, so a customer using both counts as two connections; the 5 included connections are shared across both types. The pricing page states pay only for what you use starting free up to 7,500 users and shows a calculator for M2M tokens, but does not publish a per-user price past the free allowance.

retention.stated: unverified: no user-data, session or audit-log retention period for the Pay as you go plan is stated on the pricing, API or rate-limit pages read
retention.notes: Enterprise adds audit log streaming; no retention duration is stated on the pricing page.

egress.terms: not applicable: a hosted authentication API; no traffic allowance or egress term is published on the pricing page

interface_detail: REST APIs grouped as Authentication APIs (login, MFA, passwordless, social login, usually no authorization required), Management APIs (configuration, require an environment token) and Self-service APIs (user and tenant actions, user or environment token). Regional gateways are https://api.frontegg.com (EU), https://api.us.frontegg.com (US), https://api.au.frontegg.com (AU) and https://api.ca.frontegg.com (CA). A bearer token from POST /auth/vendor with a Client ID and API Key authorizes Management calls; OpenAPI specifications and generated SDKs are published.
tooling: Frontegg frontend SDKs (React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, JavaScript) and backend SDKs (Node.js, Python, Java) or JWKS token validation, a generated TypeScript SDK from the OpenAPI spec, or any HTTP client against the REST APIs.
chaining: Hosted login and tenant store for a web app; a custom domain pairs with a name from domains-dns, and SSO or SCIM enterprise connections consume the 5 included allowances on Pay as you go.

limits.value: 7,500 monthly active users on Pay as you go
5 enterprise connections (SSO/SCIM) on Pay as you go
general API rate limit 100 requests per minute per IP on the Launch tier (1,000 per minute on Scale and Enterprise); 429 on exceed
user sign-up 5 per minute per VendorId on Launch (10 per minute per IP on Scale); user password authentication 10 per minute per VendorId on Launch

limits_note: Many per-endpoint rate limits are keyed per IP or per VendorId (environment ID); the vocabulary has no separate kind for a per-environment key, so per-environment-key limits are named in text.
binding_note: The 7,500 monthly active user ceiling and the 5 shared SSO/SCIM connections are the first limits reached; per-IP and per-VendorId rate limits bind on individual high-volume endpoints.

identity_cost.detail: The first-party quickstart states: sign up with your email or GitHub/Google account from frontegg.com Start for free; the pricing page states no credit card is needed to start. The rendered form fields of the signup portal (portal.frontegg.com/signup) are unverified behind a login wall. Whether a later step asks for a phone number or card is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: An API request that exceeds a rate limit answers HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; the vendor recommends a back-off strategy. Limits are scoped per IP address or per environment ID (Vendor ID).
confidence_note: Quota, connection allowance and no-card statement are quoted from the first-party pricing page; rate limits from the first-party developer docs and API access from the first-party API overview. The signup gate is from the first-party quickstart; the login-walled signup form itself was not readable, so its fields are unverified and the rung stays documented.
